description: One day, a girl suddenly confesses to him. Wanting to reject her without causing trouble, he decides to find a fake girlfriend. However, his plan backfires and throws him into an increasingly chaotic romantic battlefield. The girls around him include the tsundere 'Vicious Princess' from the Archery Club, the flirtatious 'White Fox' who is skilled at teasing, the black-haired 'Flower of the Highlands', and his extremely brocon sister. What begins as a simple fake-girlfriend arrangement soon turns into a complicated youth romantic comedy.
author: Hua Zhi Chu Si / Yuzhou
